title: Embedding Vector Search Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI for EE Research
description: Prediction activity in an illustrative two-dimensional embedding space. Learners predict which two of six stored passages vector search returns for each of three queries, in order, and whether the second result clears a cosine-similarity threshold of 0.90. After each answer the sim shows every cosine similarity, the ranking, and the reason; after the third query an exploration mode lets learners drag the query vector and watch the ranking update.

educational.topic: Embeddings, cosine similarity, and top-k vector search with a similarity threshold
learningObjectives: Infer, from the angles between vectors in a two-dimensional toy embedding space, which two stored passages vector search returns for each of three queries and whether the second result clears a similarity threshold of 0.90
Explain why a similarity threshold is needed when top-k search always returns k results

accessibility.notes: describe() provides a screen-reader description; all controls are native HTML selects and buttons reachable with the Tab key; correct and incorrect feedback uses words and check or X symbols as well as a blue/orange color-blind-safe palette; all body text is 16 px.

controls.label: First result
controls.purpose: Chooses the passage (D1 to D6) predicted to rank first. Disabled after Submit.

controls.label: Second result
controls.purpose: Chooses the passage predicted to rank second; must differ from the first. Disabled after Submit.

controls.label: Threshold mark
controls.purpose: Marks the second result as clears threshold or below threshold (cosine >= 0.90). Disabled after Submit.

controls.label: Submit
controls.purpose: Commits the single attempt for the current query. Enabled when two different passages and a mark are chosen.

controls.label: Next Query / Open Exploration
controls.purpose: Enabled after Submit. Advances to the next query, and after Q3 opens exploration mode.

controls.label: Query vector (exploration)
controls.purpose: In exploration, dragging inside the plot or pressing the arrow keys moves the query vector; the ranking table and threshold marks update live. Not scored.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict-then-reveal with concrete computed values, followed by free exploration
keyQuestions: Which two passages will vector search return?
Does the second result clear the 0.90 threshold?
What does search return when the query is far from every passage?
commonMisconceptions: Vector search matches words, not meanings.
The top results are always good matches.
Retrieval returns the passage that is closest in distance, not in direction.
assessmentOpportunities: 3 of 3 queries correct (both passages, their order, and the threshold mark) is evidence of mastery
Learner explains why D1 is returned for Q3 even though it is below the threshold
